Allah asks a question. What are people asking each other about?
They are asking about the big news. It is the Day of Judgment.
Some people believe it and some do not. They argue about it.
Allah says: No! Soon they will know the truth.
He says it again: Soon they will know.
Allah made the earth like a soft bed for you.
He made the mountains like pegs to keep the earth steady.
He made you in pairs, boys and girls.
He made sleep so your body can rest.
He made the night like a cover for you.
He made the day for you to work and get what you need.
He made seven strong skies above you.
He put a bright lamp in the sky. This is the sun.
He sends down lots of rain from the clouds.
With the rain He grows grain and plants.
And gardens full of thick trees.
The Day of Judgment has a set time. It will come when Allah says.
On that Day, a horn is blown and you will all come out in big groups.
The sky will open like many doors.
The mountains will move away. They will look like they are not there.
Hell is waiting.
It is a home for people who did very wrong.
They will stay there for a very long time.
They will not taste anything cool or any drink there.
They will only have boiling water and dirty liquid.
This is the fair payment for what they did.
They did not think they would be asked about what they did.
They said no to Our verses and said they were lies.
But We counted everything and wrote it down.
They will be told: Taste it! We will only give you more punishment.
But people who feared and respected Allah will win.
They will have gardens and grapes.
And friends the same age as them.
And a full cup to drink.
There they will not hear any bad talk or lies.
This is a gift from your Lord. It is a big gift, and it is just what they earned.
He is the Lord of the sky and the earth and all that is between. He is the Most Kind. No one can speak to Him unless He says yes.
On that Day, Jibril and the angels will stand in rows. No one will speak unless Allah says yes. And he will only say what is right.
That is the True Day. So whoever wants to, should find a way back to his Lord by doing good.
Allah has warned you about a punishment that is near. On that Day, a person will see what he did. And the one who said no will say: I wish I was just dust!
